Name: Alarm Clock
Author: calebstein1
Description:
Alarm Clock (formerly Counting Sheep) changes the sleeping mechanic of Stardew Valley; you'll set your alarm clock each night before bed, allowing you to wake up anytime between 5am and 10am, but you'll need to make sure you're getting enough sleep or you'll find yourself extra exhausted in the morning!

The penalty for not sleeping enough has been increased from what it is in the base game. Getting fewer than 8 hours of sleep will result in starting the next day with 75% of your maximum stamina, and getting fewer than 6 hours will cause you to start at half stamina, so make sure you're taking care of yourself and sleeping enough!

The usual disclaimer, beta software and all that, none of this mod should have any side-effects but if you find something odd please let me know! Also, as always, available in [url=https://github.com/calebstein1/countingsheep]GitHub[/url] as well.
